title: Shadow hunt outdoors
offscreen: The next day, at the same time, go back and look at the same shadow: has it changed? Mark the spot with a stone.

items.label: The shadow of a tree
items.say: With a grown-up, look for the shadow of a tree or a pole. Stay on the sidewalk or in the garden.

items.label: Your shadow
items.say: Now your own shadow. Move slowly: what does it do?

items.label: Where the sun reaches
items.say: And a place where the sun reaches and one where it doesn't. Which is warmer?

items.label: The shadow of a fallen leaf
items.say: Look for a leaf that has already fallen on the ground and look at its shadow.

items.label: The shadow of a stone
items.say: Now a stone: where is its shadow? On the side away from the sun.

items.label: A shadow that changes shape
items.say: Last, a shadow that changes shape when you move.

intro.bo: {nome}, shall we go on a treasure hunt? You look, I'll wait for you here. One thing at a time.
intro.pilu: {nome}, I'll tell you something to look for. Look carefully around you: treasures are everywhere.
intro.tango: Treasure hunt, {nome}! I'm coming too! ...No, I'll stay here. You look, slowly.

outro.bo: So many treasures, {nome}. Now each one goes back in its place, so we can find them again tomorrow.
outro.pilu: Every treasure goes back where you found it, {nome}: that's part of the game too.
outro.tango: What a hunt! {nome}, shall we put everything back? I'll... I'll keep an eye on it.
